title: The Vanishing Statue
scene: At 4:55 PM, the gallery statue vanished. The main hall was closed during an alarm test from 4:40 to 5:10.

suspects.name: Vera Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the office at 4:55, updating records.
suspects.alibiProof: The office camera shows Vera at 4:53.

suspects.name: Walter Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the side door at 4:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The door camera shows Walter at 4:54 and 5:02.

suspects.name: Xiomara Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe at 4:55.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Xiomara is stamped 4:56.

suspects.name: Yosef Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the main hall at 4:55, moving the statue base.
suspects.contradiction: The hall was closed by the alarm test, and statue dust marked Yosef's coat.
